findings.text: The provenance says job 1318468 "wrote MAST's and ITER's rows, linearised and full-fit alike", but study/results/mast-main.jsonl, mast-control.jsonl and both MAST scaling files were last written 2026-11-15T20:18:33-20:18:34, inside job 1317749's span (14:24:53-20:19:41), and study/study-titan-20261115T132451Z.log records "FAST main case=mast rows=256" before that job ends; only the mast-verify-*.jsonl files (20:59-21:02) belong to 1318468, so an auditor following the receipts finds the linearised MAST rows produced by the other job and cannot trust the job-to-row mapping this repair round exists to establish.

The sentence says sacct records job 1317749 as FAILED "because its figure drawing raised", but that log's terminal traceback is a RuntimeError "the forward evaluation did not qualify" raised from hybrid_study.py:233 in verify_arm(mast, main) at study/study-titan-20261115T132451Z.log:78-96, while the figure-drawing ValueError was caught and logged as "STATE-FAILED solovev" with the job continuing to the MAST work, so the stated cause is contradicted by the log it cites.

"Every realisation row carries its own seed" is false for the receipts it names: all 768 linearised rows (for example study/results/solovev-main.jsonl, whose keys are coefficients, covariance, reduced_chi_square, iterations, forward_evaluations, converged, flux_rms and realisation) carry no seed field, and neither do the 14 Solov'ev full-fit rows; only the MAST and ITER verify rows carry seed, so a reader trying to reproduce a linearised realisation by its seed finds none and must instead reconstruct it from the arm seed plus the realisation index in study/hybrid_study.py:97-107.
